observation.visible_scene: Against a black background, a hand grips the right edge of a reflective CD/DVD disc. A small candle flame appears as a bright vertical streak at the bottom center, and its light shines through the disc's central hole, creating a glowing ring around the dark hole and a bright rounded blob just below it. The disc surface shows rainbow diffraction colors.
visible_changes: In the early frames the disc is covered by broad concentric rainbow rings (red, green, magenta).
As the clip progresses the rainbow colors redistribute into two curved arcs flanking the center hole (left and right), while the outer edge of the disc resolves into a thin bright circular rim.
The disc and holding hand drift slightly within the frame (small positional/tilt change), the disc shifting a little left and up relative to the frame borders.
The flame streak at the bottom and the bright glow around the hole remain approximately fixed in position and intensity throughout.
outside_clip_unknowns: What physically changed to alter the diffraction pattern (disc tilt, rotation, or relative motion of the flame) is not determined within the excerpt.
The full environment and the rest of the flame setup are not visible.
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent movement is object motion or slight camera motion, since the background is featureless.
Whether the bright blob below the hole is the flame seen through the hole or a reflection/transmission artifact.
Whether the disc is spinning or merely tilting; the pattern change is gradual and could result from either.
